items.stem: Who is recognized as the Father of Histology who classified 21 elementary animal tissue types?
items.explanation: Xavier Bichat coined the term 'tissue' and identified 21 fundamental tissue types without using a microscope.

items.stem: Animal tissue grade of structural organization first evolved in which animal phylum?
items.explanation: Cnidarians (Coelenterates) are the first metazoans to exhibit true tissue-level organization.
